summary.en: Lecturer (Assistant Professor) in Digital Planning at the University of Glasgow, working on GeoAI and urban digital twins in quantitative urban geography.
summary.zh: 格拉斯哥大学数字规划讲师（助理教授），从事定量城市地理学研究，专注于 GeoAI 与城市数字孪生。

affiliation.en: Lecturer in Digital Planning, University of Glasgow
affiliation.zh: 格拉斯哥大学数字规划讲师

body.en: I am a Lecturer (Assistant Professor) in Digital Planning at the University of Glasgow. I work in quantitative urban geography, specialising in GeoAI and urban digital twin research, and I hold a PhD in Geography from the University of Leicester.
body.zh: 我是格拉斯哥大学数字规划讲师（助理教授），研究领域为定量城市地理学，专注于 GeoAI 与城市数字孪生研究，拥有英国莱斯特大学地理学博士学位。

body.en: Before joining Glasgow, I was a Senior Postdoctoral Researcher and Coordinator at the Future Cities Laboratory, Singapore-ETH Centre. In 2023 I was also a Lecturer in Human Geography and Urban Planning at Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, and I previously held postdoctoral positions at the NUS Urban Analytics Lab and the University of Helsinki.
body.zh: 加入格拉斯哥大学之前，我曾任新加坡-ETH 中心未来城市实验室高级博士后研究员兼协调员，并于 2023 年在南京信息工程大学担任人文地理与城市规划方向讲师。此前，我在新加坡国立大学城市分析实验室和赫尔辛基大学从事博士后研究。

body.en: I am passionate about integrating geospatial analytics, artificial intelligence and digital twins into urban studies, and about developing the theories, algorithms and models that make this integration possible. I also advocate open data in academia and have helped organise international OpenStreetMap academic conferences, including the 2022 State of the Map Academic Track and OSMScience 2023.
body.zh: 我致力于把地理空间分析、人工智能与数字孪生融入城市研究，发展支撑这一融合的理论、算法与模型。我也倡导学术界的开放数据，曾参与组织 OpenStreetMap 国际学术会议，包括 2022 年 State of the Map 学术分会和 2023 年 OSMScience。

body.en: I am always keen to explore collaborations and welcome enquiries from prospective PhD students who want to push the boundaries of urban science and GeoAI. Feel free to get in touch to discuss ideas; I am always happy to start a conversation over a coffee.
body.zh: 我乐于探索各类合作机会，也欢迎有志于推动城市科学与 GeoAI 前沿的博士申请者与我联系。欢迎来信讨论想法，我随时愿意从一杯咖啡开始交流。

value.en: GeoAI, urban digital twins, quantitative urban geography, geospatial analytics
value.zh: GeoAI、城市数字孪生、定量城市地理学、地理空间分析

value.en: PhD in Geography, University of Leicester
value.zh: 英国莱斯特大学地理学博士

summary.en: PhD researcher in Urban Studies at the University of Glasgow, focusing on urban data science, human mobility and graph neural networks.
summary.zh: 格拉斯哥大学城市研究博士生，专注于城市数据科学、人类移动性与图神经网络。

affiliation.zh: 格拉斯哥大学城市研究

value.en: Urban data science, human mobility, graph neural networks
value.zh: 城市数据科学、人类移动性、图神经网络

summary.en: PhD student in Urban Studies at the University of Glasgow, using spatial data and GeoAI to study cities, environments and human well-being.
summary.zh: 格拉斯哥大学城市研究博士生，运用空间数据与 GeoAI 研究城市、环境与人类福祉。

affiliation.zh: 格拉斯哥大学城市研究

body.en: I am a PhD student in Urban Studies at the University of Glasgow, with a background in landscape architecture, architecture, spatial data science and GeoAI. My research uses spatial data and computational methods to understand cities, environments and human well-being.
body.zh: 我是格拉斯哥大学城市研究方向的博士生，学科背景涵盖风景园林、建筑学、空间数据科学与 GeoAI。我的研究借助空间数据与计算方法，理解城市、环境与人类福祉。

body.en: GeoAI, remote sensing, urban analytics and environmental justice, as well as the emerging use of multimodal AI and large language models in geographic research.
body.zh: GeoAI、遥感、城市分析与环境正义，以及多模态 AI 和大语言模型在地理研究中的新兴应用。

body.en: Before joining Glasgow, I studied Landscape Architecture and Architecture at Beijing Forestry University and worked on interdisciplinary research with the Harvard Spatial Data Lab and the University of Southern California. My earlier projects explored urban green-space equity, environmental quality and health, the built environment, remote sensing and AI-assisted spatial analysis.
body.zh: 来格拉斯哥之前，我在北京林业大学学习风景园林与建筑学，并曾与哈佛大学空间数据实验室、南加州大学合作开展跨学科研究。此前的项目涉及城市绿地公平、环境质量与健康、建成环境、遥感以及 AI 辅助的空间分析。

body.en: I enjoy working across disciplines, turning real-world urban and environmental questions into research that combines spatial thinking, data and emerging technologies. I am always glad to connect with researchers and practitioners in GeoAI, urban science, remote sensing, environmental justice and human-centred AI.
body.zh: 我喜欢跨学科的工作，乐于把现实中的城市与环境问题转化为融合空间思维、数据与新技术的研究，也欢迎 GeoAI、城市科学、遥感、环境正义和以人为本的 AI 等领域的研究者与从业者交流。

value.en: Landscape Architecture and Architecture, Beijing Forestry University
value.zh: 北京林业大学，风景园林与建筑学

summary.en: PhD student at Maynooth University and visiting postgraduate researcher at the University of Glasgow, working on urban region representation learning.
summary.zh: 梅努斯大学博士生、格拉斯哥大学访问研究生，研究城市区域表征学习。

affiliation.en: Maynooth University · Visiting postgraduate researcher, University of Glasgow
affiliation.zh: 梅努斯大学 · 格拉斯哥大学访问研究生

body.en: I am a PhD student at Maynooth University and a visiting postgraduate researcher at the University of Glasgow. I previously studied at the University of Trento (Italy), where I obtained a master's in data science and worked on urban micro-mobility during my research placement. My current research focuses on urban region representation learning, with the aim of obtaining general-purpose spatial embeddings, suitable for different downstream tasks and cities.
body.zh: 我是梅努斯大学（Maynooth University）的博士生，目前在格拉斯哥大学做访问研究生。此前我在意大利特伦托大学（University of Trento）获得数据科学硕士学位，并在研究实习期间从事城市微出行研究。我目前的研究聚焦于城市区域表征学习，目标是得到通用的空间嵌入，适用于不同的下游任务和不同的城市。

value.en: Urban region representation learning, general-purpose spatial embeddings, urban micro-mobility
value.zh: 城市区域表征学习、通用空间嵌入、城市微出行

summary.en: A warm welcome to Luisa Lo Presti, a visiting PhD student from Maynooth University, where she works with Dr Peter Mooney. She is spending seven weeks with the Urban Analytics Subject Group at the University of Glasgow and the Urban Big Data Centre, sharing research ideas and exploring new collaborations. Welcome to Glasgow, Luisa!
summary.zh: 热烈欢迎来自梅努斯大学的访问博士生 Luisa Lo Presti！她在梅努斯与 Peter Mooney 博士一起开展研究，接下来七周将在格拉斯哥大学城市分析学科组和城市大数据中心访问，交流研究想法、探索新的合作。欢迎来到格拉斯哥，Luisa！

summary.en: A trip to Pollok Country Park in Pollokshaws to meet the Highland cows, celebrating Yunlong Liu and Qin Li joining Liu’s Gate as new PhD students.
summary.zh: 去 Pollokshaws 的 Pollok 公园看高地牛，庆祝刘云龙和李秦两位新同学加入刘家门。

summary.en: Professor of Geocomputation at the University of Glasgow and a Group Leader of UIA (Urban Intelligence & Analytics). She describes herself as a methodologist: she adapts and develops AI/ML approaches to solve problems in different domains.
summary.zh: 格拉斯哥大学地理计算教授，UIA（Urban Intelligence & Analytics）的团队负责人（Group Leader）之一。她称自己是一名方法论学者（methodologist）：改造并发展 AI/ML 方法，用来解决不同领域的问题。

affiliation.en: Urban Studies & Social Policy, School of Social & Political Sciences, University of Glasgow
affiliation.zh: 格拉斯哥大学社会与政治科学学院 · 城市研究与社会政策

intro.en: UIA describes its work as “Understanding cities to build better futures”: it studies how cities work and how they change over time, using data, computer models and artificial intelligence.
intro.zh: UIA 用“Understanding cities to build better futures”（理解城市，建设更好的未来）来概括自己的工作：用数据、计算机模型和人工智能，研究城市如何运行、如何随时间变化。

lead.en: Alison Heppenstall is one of its Group Leaders.
lead.zh: Alison Heppenstall 是 UIA 的团队负责人（Group Leader）之一。

summary.en: UIA describes its work as “Understanding cities to build better futures”: it studies how cities work and how they change over time, using data, computer models and artificial intelligence. It builds computer simulations of cities and their populations, much of it with agent-based models, microsimulation and synthetic population generation, so that decision-makers can explore what a policy might do before they commit to it. Its projects range across housing, transport, energy, health and the environment, among them AI4CI, HealthMod, SIPHER, OPTIMA and ExAMPLER.
summary.zh: UIA 用“Understanding cities to build better futures”（理解城市，建设更好的未来）来概括自己的工作：用数据、计算机模型和人工智能，研究城市如何运行、如何随时间变化。团队为城市及其人口建立计算机仿真，多采用智能体模型、微观模拟与合成人口生成等方法，让决策者在定下政策之前，先探索它可能带来什么。项目涉及住房、交通、能源、健康与环境，包括 AI4CI、HealthMod、SIPHER、OPTIMA 和 ExAMPLER。

connection.en: Pengyuan Liu, the supervisor of Liu’s Gate, is listed among UIA’s Associates.
connection.zh: 刘家门的导师刘鹏远，在 UIA 官网上列为 Associate。

body.en: She took her first degree in Archaeology at Grey College, University of Durham, and encountered programming and Geocomputation during her Master’s at the University of Leeds. Her PhD built agent-based models for empirical applications. She went on to hold EPSRC and ESRC Fellowships focused on Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence approaches, and the inaugural ESRC-Turing Fellowship. At Leeds she was involved in the Leeds Institute for Data Analytics, the Consumer Data Research Centre and the Urban Analytics Programme at the Alan Turing Institute. In 2022 she was awarded the International Society of Computational Economics prize for outstanding contribution in computational social simulation, from the Italian Research Council. She is a member of the DSAB at the Joint BioSecurity Council and of the Royal Geographical Society, and a current Alan Turing Fellow.
body.zh: 她本科就读于杜伦大学格雷学院（Grey College），学的是考古学；在利兹大学读硕士期间接触到编程与地理计算（Geocomputation），博士阶段为实证应用构建智能体模型。此后她先后获得 EPSRC 与 ESRC 的 Fellowship，专注于机器学习/人工智能方法，并获得首届 ESRC-Turing Fellowship。在利兹期间，她参与了利兹数据分析研究所（Leeds Institute for Data Analytics）、消费者数据研究中心（Consumer Data Research Centre）和艾伦·图灵研究所的城市分析项目（Urban Analytics Programme）。2022 年，她获得意大利研究委员会（Italian Research Council）颁发的国际计算经济学会奖（International Society of Computational Economics prize），表彰她在计算社会模拟方面的杰出贡献。她是 Joint BioSecurity Council 下设 DSAB 的成员、皇家地理学会会员，现为 Alan Turing Fellow。

body.en: She has extensive experience with spatial agent-based models, microsimulation and evolutionary approaches, and strong interests in uncertainty quantification, reinforcement learning and data assimilation. She is also interested in exascale computation for the social sciences, which ties into her work on urban digital twins at local and national level. Her grants include AI for Collective Intelligence (AI4CI), an EPSRC-funded AI Hub led from the University of Bristol, whose Smart Cities theme she leads with CASA at UCL; Exascale agent-based modelling for policy evaluation in real-time (ExAMPLER); the HealthMod Cluster; and Systems Science in Public Health and Health Economics Research (SIPHER). At Glasgow she is listed in two research groups, Urban Analytics and Just Cities & Societies.
body.zh: 她在空间智能体模型、微观模拟和演化方法方面经验丰富，对不确定性量化、强化学习和数据同化有浓厚兴趣，也关注面向社会科学的 exascale（百亿亿次）计算，这与她在地方和国家层面参与的城市数字孪生工作相关。她的科研项目包括 AI for Collective Intelligence（AI4CI：由 EPSRC 资助、布里斯托大学牵头的人工智能中心，她与伦敦大学学院的 CASA 一起负责其中的 Smart Cities 主题）、Exascale agent-based modelling for policy evaluation in real-time（ExAMPLER）、HealthMod Cluster，以及 Systems Science in Public Health and Health Economics Research（SIPHER）。在格拉斯哥大学，她所在的研究组有 Urban Analytics 和 Just Cities & Societies。

label.zh: 格拉斯哥大学教师主页

summary.en: Associate Professor at the National University of Singapore and the founder and principal investigator of UAL (Urban Analytics Lab). His interests are urban informatics, 3D city modelling and 3D GIS, and GeoAI.
summary.zh: 新加坡国立大学副教授，UAL（Urban Analytics Lab）的创立者和首席研究员（principal investigator）。他的研究兴趣是城市信息学（Urban informatics）、三维城市建模与三维 GIS（3D city modelling, 3D GIS），以及 GeoAI。

affiliation.en: Department of Architecture, College of Design and Engineering, National University of Singapore
affiliation.zh: 新加坡国立大学设计与工程学院 · 建筑系

intro.en: UAL describes itself as “A GeoAI research group at the National University of Singapore”: it develops quantitative methods and tools that use emerging urban and geospatial data and AI to sense the form, function and human experience of cities.
intro.zh: UAL 用“A GeoAI research group at the National University of Singapore”（新加坡国立大学的一个 GeoAI 研究团队）来介绍自己：它开发定量的方法与工具，借助新兴的城市与地理空间数据和人工智能，感知城市的形态、功能以及人在城市中的体验。

lead.en: UAL was established by Filip Biljecki, who directs it.
lead.zh: UAL 由 Filip Biljecki 创立并领导。

summary.en: UAL describes itself as “A GeoAI research group at the National University of Singapore”: it develops quantitative methods and tools that use emerging urban and geospatial data and AI to sense the form, function and human experience of cities. Its research spans six themes: street-level imagery, new urban data, urban dynamics and change, trustworthy urban data and AI, the human experience of cities, and 3D city models and digital twins. Across these themes it develops GeoAI methods and releases open data and software, among them Global Streetscapes, ZenSVI, VoxCity and OpenFACADES.
summary.zh: UAL 用“A GeoAI research group at the National University of Singapore”（新加坡国立大学的一个 GeoAI 研究团队）来介绍自己：它开发定量的方法与工具，借助新兴的城市与地理空间数据和人工智能，感知城市的形态、功能以及人在城市中的体验。它的研究分为六个主题：街景影像（Street-level imagery）、新型城市数据（New urban data）、城市动态与变化（Urban dynamics and change）、可信的城市数据与人工智能（Trustworthy urban data and AI）、人在城市中的体验（Human experience of cities），以及三维城市模型与数字孪生（3D city models and digital twins）。围绕这些主题，它开发 GeoAI 方法，发布开放数据与软件，其中有 Global Streetscapes、ZenSVI、VoxCity 和 OpenFACADES。

connection.en: Pengyuan Liu, the supervisor of Liu’s Gate, is listed among UAL’s alumni, as a Research Fellow.
connection.zh: 刘家门的导师刘鹏远，名列 UAL 官网的 Alumni 名单，身份是 Research Fellow。

body.en: His background is in geomatic engineering. He holds a PhD, with highest honours, and an MSc from TU Delft, and a BSc in Geodesy and Geoinformatics from the University of Zagreb. In UAL’s early years he was appointed NUS Presidential Young Professor. His awards include the Young Researcher Award in GIScience from the Austrian Academy of Sciences, the Gill Memorial Award from the Royal Geographical Society (with the Institute of British Geographers) in 2026, and the NUS Annual Teaching Excellence Award in 2025.
body.zh: 他的专业背景是测绘工程（Geomatic engineering）。他在代尔夫特理工大学（TU Delft）获得博士学位（最高荣誉，with highest honours）和硕士学位，在萨格勒布大学（University of Zagreb）获得大地测量与地理信息学（Geodesy and Geoinformatics）学士学位。在 UAL 创立初期，他获聘为新加坡国立大学校长青年教授（NUS Presidential Young Professor）。他获得的奖项包括奥地利科学院（Austrian Academy of Sciences）的 GIScience 青年研究者奖（Young Researcher Award in GIScience）、2026 年英国皇家地理学会（Royal Geographical Society with IBG）颁发的吉尔纪念奖（Gill Memorial Award），以及 2025 年新加坡国立大学年度卓越教学奖（Annual Teaching Excellence Award）。

body.en: He works on urban informatics, 3D city modelling and 3D GIS, and GeoAI, and leads UAL as its principal investigator. He is an associate editor of two journals: Computers, Environment and Urban Systems, and Landscape and Urban Planning.
body.zh: 他的研究方向是城市信息学、三维城市建模与三维 GIS 以及 GeoAI，并以首席研究员的身份领导 UAL。他还担任两本期刊的副主编（associate editor）：Computers, Environment and Urban Systems 和 Landscape and Urban Planning。
